name: Dark Intent heals 5% of maximum health when Lunge lands (#2831)
contract: Dark Intent 707622 is the rank a Bloodmage owns (CharacterAdvancement class 20, and present in the live-client capture). Its tooltip is "When you Lunge at an enemy you now heal for $504831s1% of your maximum health", and its single effect is aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL with EffectTriggerSpell 504831 ("Heal 5%": SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT, BasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5, on the caster), ProcChance 100 and Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0x0. With no `spell_proc` row SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated nothing and the heal never fired. Lunge 500126 is the only family-26 record with SpellFamilyFlags (16777216, 0, 0); it has DmgClass NONE and is harmful, so the proc belongs on ProcFlags 4096 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_NONE_DMG_CLASS_NEG). Lunge is PowerType -2 (POWER_HEALTH) with ManaCostPercentage 8 and CasterAuraSpell 525031, one of the two Cursed Form markers, so the caster must be in a Cursed Form to cast it and the cast itself costs 8 percentage points of maximum health. The discriminating assertion is therefore the signed health_pct change across the Lunge: today's tree loses about 8 points, while the 5% heal leaves a loss of about 3. The bound -5 sits between the two and the bound 0 keeps the assertion from passing on an unrelated gain.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
A Cursed Form is active so Lunge is castable
Let the Cursed Form marker settle
Let the leap and its proc resolve
Lunge's 8% health cost is offset by the 5% Dark Intent heal
